---
title: "📦 ae04-multiple-regression-part-1"
subtitle: "From simple to multiple regression"
---

Five exercises taking you from a simple-regression recap through multiple regression, linearity diagnostics, a hedonic price model and omitted variable bias. Belongs to [Simple regression](../topics/30-simple-regression.qmd) · [Multiple regression](../topics/40-multiple-regression.qmd).

```{=html}
<p><a class="mp-download" href="/ae/ae04-multiple-regression-part-1.zip" download>⬇ Download ae04-multiple-regression-part-1.zip</a></p>
```

:::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
Unzip it, then open the `.Rproj` file in RStudio. Every path inside the exercises is relative to that project, so the data will load without edits.
::::

:::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
Uses datasets that ship with the `alr4` and `wooldridge` packages, so there is no `data/` folder — install those packages instead.
::::
